method: On the DR1 chains: angle between the principal axis of the (w0, wa) posterior and the w_p = -1 line; offset of the posterior from the line in units of sd(w_p); in (w_p, wa) coordinates, the 2D 68% and 95% credible regions (getdist) and whether the 95% region reaches w_p = -1.
text: The elongated w0-wa ellipses point closely towards the LCDM point: their major axes nearly coincide with the w_p = -1 lines at the pivots, the constraints lie on top of those lines, and after the pivot shift the contours have an accurately vertical major axis with all three 95% contours overlapping the w_p = -1 line (estimated by eye in the paper, as the chains were not public).
rests_on: The paper could not do this transformation; it is the quantitative core of the PhantomX reading.
